patch_description: Crossover of the current program (gated blended-slope lead compensation) with the prior three-scale SG-bank variant. Keep the current pipeline but: (1) add a wider first SG pass (2*sg_half) from the three-scale variant, which previously reduced slope changes (36) and false reversals (29); (2) keep the gated blended RTS-slope lead from the current program, which improved lag_error (0.33) and noise_reduction (0.68); (3) drop the redundant P_smooth RTS covariance recursion to save compute. The wider kernel suppresses spurious reversals while the gated slope-lead preserves responsiveness, targeting the smoothness bottleneck without sacrificing accuracy.
